title: Auxesis.io
tagline: A Cross-chain DeFi autopilot that rebalances assets across networks using 1inch infrastructure
description:
Auxesis: is an intelligent DeFi portfolio management system that revolutionizes how users manage their cryptocurrency assets across multiple blockchain networks. Built for ETHGlobal Unite 2025, this project leverages 1inch's comprehensive infrastructure to provide automated portfolio re-balancing, real-time analytics, and seamless cross-chain asset management.

The Problem We Solve
- Managing a diversified cryptocurrency portfolio across multiple blockchain networks is incredibly complex and time-consuming. Users face several critical challenges:
- Portfolio Drift: Market movements constantly shift asset allocations away from target percentages
- Manual Complexity: Tracking assets across 14+ chains requires constant monitoring and manual intervention
-Sub optimal Execution: Finding the best swap routes and prices across different DEXs is nearly impossible manually
Gas Inefficiency: Users often overpay for transactions due to poor timing and route selection
Time Intensive: Re-balancing portfolios manually can take hours and requires deep DeFi knowledge

Our Solution
Auxesis provides a comprehensive automated solution that transforms portfolio management from a manual chore into an intelligent, automated process:

Core Features
1. Multi-Chain Portfolio Tracking
- Real-time portfolio monitoring across 10+ blockchain networks
- Support for Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, Optimism, Avalanche, BSC, and more
- Custom chain integration including Sonic (146) and Unichain (130)
- Unified dashboard showing total portfolio value, P&L, and chain distribution

2. Intelligent Re-balancing Engine
- Drift Detection: Automatically identifies when portfolio allocations deviate from target percentages
- Smart Suggestions: Generates optimal re-balancing trades using 1inch's Quote API
- Preset Strategies: Conservative (60% stablecoins), Balanced (40% stablecoins), Aggressive (20% stablecoins)
- Custom Allocations: Users can set personalized target percentages for any supported tokens

3. Advanced 1inch Integration
- Portfolio API v4: Real-time portfolio data with profit/loss tracking
- Swap API: Optimal trade execution with best price discovery
- Quote API: Real-time pricing for re-balancing calculations
- History API: Complete transaction analytics and performance tracking
- Limit Order SDK: Advanced order types for precise execution

4. Professional User Experience
- Wallet Integration: Seamless connection via Thirdweb with support for 50+ wallet types
- Real-time Updates: Live portfolio data with auto-refresh every 10 minutes
- Mobile Responsive: Optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
- Dark Theme: Professional design with consistent branding
how_its_made:
Technical Architecture
Frontend Stack
- Next.js 15: Modern React framework with App Router for optimal performance
- TypeScript: Full type safety throughout the application
- Tailwind CSS: Utility-first styling with custom design system
- Zustand: Lightweight state management for portfolio data
- Recharts: Beautiful, responsive charts for data visualization

Blockchain Integration
- Thirdweb: Multi-chain wallet connection and authentication
- 1inch APIs: Comprehensive DeFi infrastructure integration
- Real-time Data: Live portfolio tracking with automatic updates

Key Innovations
1. Cross-Chain Portfolio Autopilot
Our intelligent re-balancing engine continuously monitors portfolio drift and suggests optimal trades:
- 5% Drift Threshold: Triggers re-balancing suggestions when allocations deviate
- Minimum Trade Size: $10 minimum to avoid dust transactions
- Gas Optimization: 20% gas buffer for reliable transaction execution
- Slippage Protection: 1% maximum slippage for trade safety
